# LUI menu-name hashes - build 1.34.0.15931218
# Harvested from _G.LUI.createMenu (the LUI menu registry) with the in-game Lua
# walker. The registry is keyed by the engine's tag -6 hashed-identifier objects;
# this is the 63-bit FNV-1a-64 name hash at +16 of each key.
#
# Paste any of these into Debug -> LUI menus -> 'Menu name or hash' and press Open
# menu. The engine only ever matches on the hash, so a menu whose NAME we could not
# recover opens exactly the same as one we could.
#
# 276 entries, 21 with a recovered name.
#
# Names beyond the original 5 were recovered by tools/hash_harvest_strings.py:
# every printable run in the decrypted exe dump, hashed and joined against this
# list. NOT brute force. The same pass finds 0 of the 2294 unknown dvar names --
# dvar names are fully baked to hashes at build time, menu names only partly.
